headword: {表外漢字|ひょうがいかんじ}

definitions.gloss: kanji not included in the {常用漢字|じょうようかんじ} list
definitions.explanation: Any character outside the 2,136 {常用漢字|じょうようかんじ} designated for general use. Newspapers and textbooks avoid them or add furigana, though many appear in names, place names, and literary writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表外漢字|ひょうがいかんじ}だ。
examples.english: This is a kanji outside the standard list.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表外漢字|ひょうがいかんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひらがな⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Newspapers often write kanji outside the standard list in hiragana instead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人名|じんめい}→人名：22206_jinmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表外漢字|ひょうがいかんじ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Since kanji outside the standard list can be used in personal names, there are many names whose readings are hard to guess.

notes:
The ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ refers to the {常用漢字表|じょうようかんじひょう}, the official table of characters for general use, so {表外|ひょうがい} means "off the table."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表外漢字|ひょうがいかんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a non-standard kanji
- {表外漢字|ひょうがいかんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ルビ→ルビ：21516_rubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふる: to add furigana to a non-standard kanji
- {表外|ひょうがい}⟦{読|よ}み→読み：00425_yomi⟧: a reading not listed for a standard kanji

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧: the standard list itself
- ⟦{人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}→人名用漢字：30112_jinmeiyoukanji⟧: kanji additionally permitted in personal names
- ⟦{旧字体|きゅうじたい}→旧字体：27161_kyuujitai⟧: pre-1949 character forms — a question of form rather than of list membership
